datasheet_identity.title: SS12 THRU SS120 SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: Target identity is SS18 in the SS12 THRU SS120 family; manufacturer footer identifies Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd. Citation: datasheet p. 1.

SS18 ratings on p. 1 are VRRM=80 V, VRMS=56 V, and VDC=80 V, with maximum average forward rectified current IF(AV)=1.0 A and non-repetitive peak forward surge current IFSM=30 A at t=8.3 ms half-sine wave. VRRM/VDC are reverse-voltage ratings, not a stated breakdown-voltage test, so breakdown_voltage and breakdown_current are null.

The reverse-current table also gives maximum IR2=50 mA at VR=VDC and TA=100°C for SS18. The single reverse_current field stores IR1=0.5 mA at TA=25°C; IR2 is retained here to preserve the second temperature condition. Citation: datasheet p. 2, Electrical Characteristics.
Polarity is explicitly stated as: cathode line denotes the cathode end. Citation: datasheet p. 1, Mechanical Data.

The plotted points are digitized from the target-containing curve groups only: Fig. 3 dotted SS18-SS110 and Fig. 4 dashed SS18-SS120. Fig. 1 is not included because its SS15-SS120 derating group does not isolate SS18; Fig. 2 is not included because it has no target-labelled curve.
